title: event.devicecert-rotation-resolved.v1.payload
description: Emitted when a device acks (回执) a rotate-cert command to a terminal outcome. Drives the cert-renewal completion consumer: succeeded advances the device's observed cert state (epoch+1, new expiry); failed/rejected feed failure observability only.

deviceId.description: Device whose rotate-cert command reached a terminal ack.

epoch.description: The cert epoch that was rotated (the rotate-cert command's epoch, >= 1). On succeeded the consumer CAS-advances the device row from this epoch to epoch+1.

outcome.description: Terminal ack outcome mapped from command.AckReason. The consumer still validates the wire value (an out-of-set value is a permanent producer-side violation routed to DLX): json decoding does not enforce enum membership.

resolvedAt.description: Instant the device acked the rotate-cert command (ack time). The new cert expiry is computed server-side as resolvedAt + domain.CertValidity.
